sources.empty: Cited sources will appear here. Select one to read the original text.

chat.title: Chat
chat.welcomeTitle: What do you need to look up?
chat.welcomeBody: Write your question; if the law is from a state or municipality, use “Change”. Every assertion cites its source and follow-up questions keep the sources already cited.
chat.ex1: What are the grounds for terminating an employment relationship without liability for the employer?
chat.ex2: How many hours can a daytime work shift last?
chat.ex3: What rights does a worker have during pregnancy?

research.title: Research
research.welcomeBody: State the research question. The result is a dossier with the issue, the applicable law, case law, analysis and cited sources, exportable to PDF.
research.placeholder: Describe the legal problem to research…
research.question: Question
research.ex1: What severance is owed to a worker for unjustified dismissal?
research.ex2: What requirements must the employer's termination notice meet?

case.newBody: Describe the facts and the side you represent. In each round, write an argument and ask for the opposing counsel's attack or for the argument to be strengthened with the sources.
case.title: Case name
case.claim: Claim or theory of the case
case.privacyNote: The facts are stored for your user only, inside the firm, and never leave this machine.
case.composerPlaceholder: Write the argument you want to test…

example.title: Dismissal without written notice
example.facts: The employee worked three years as an administrative assistant. On March 3 she was dismissed verbally; the employer gave her no written termination notice. The employer now alleges dishonesty that it never documented.

workbench.refusalReady: There are not enough sources to answer; suggestions are shown.
workbench.busyElsewhere: An answer is in progress in another conversation. You can send when it finishes.
workbench.examplesLabel: Not sure where to start? Try an example:

scope.personaHelp: The profile guides vocabulary and the order of sources; it neither widens nor narrows the jurisdiction.
scope.historicalHelp: Turn it on only if you need what a law said before an amendment.

home.title: What do you need to do today?
home.intro: A legal research assistant that answers only from the loaded laws and cites every source. When it finds no basis, it says so instead of making it up.
home.choose: Choose how you want to work

conversar.title: Chat
conversar.text: Ask legal questions and continue with follow-up questions, as in a conversation.
conversar.when: Use it for specific questions: “What does the law say about…?”

investigacion.title: Research
investigacion.text: State a problem and get an organized dossier: the issue, the applicable law, analysis and sources.
investigacion.when: Use it to prepare a brief or a memo; it can be exported to PDF.

argumentar.title: Argue
argumentar.text: Describe a case and test your arguments: the system acts as opposing counsel or strengthens them.
argumentar.when: Use it to prepare a hearing or anticipate the other lawyer's objections.

home.step1: Write your question. By default it searches Mexican federal law; you can change the jurisdiction with the “Change” button.
home.step2: Wait for the answer: with the local model it takes 1.5 to 4 minutes. The screen shows the current stage.
home.step3: Check the sources: every citation marked with ✓ opens the original text of the law with the passage highlighted.
home.step4: If there are not enough sources, the system says so and suggests what to do. It is not an error: it guarantees nothing is made up.

leyes.title: Laws
leyes.text: Read each law by titles, chapters and articles, and compare its versions.

verificar.title: Verify citations
verificar.text: Paste or upload a brief and check that each cited article exists, is current and says what is attributed to it.

asuntos.title: Matters
asuntos.text: Group chats, research, cases, sources and notes by matter, and share them with your colleagues.

reformas.title: Amendments
reformas.text: See which laws changed and which part of your work cites amended provisions.

matters.title: Matters
matters.intro: Each matter gathers the work on one client file. Only you and the colleagues you add can see it.
matters.loadError: The matters could not be loaded. Please try again.
matters.empty: You have no matters yet. Create the first one with the form above.
matters.privacy: The matter is private: only you and the people you add can see it.
matters.notFound: The matter does not exist or you have no access to it.
matters.confirmDelete: Delete the matter? Its conversations are not deleted: they become private to their authors again.
matters.noWork: There are no conversations in this matter yet.
matters.reformedOpen: This source was amended after it was saved.
matters.sourcesHelp: To save a source, open it (from an answer or from Laws) and use “Save to matter”.
matters.addMember: Add a colleague from the firm
matters.noColleagues: There are no more colleagues from the firm to add.
matters.membersHelp: People you add see the whole matter and can work on it; only the owner manages it.

picker.label: Matter
picker.help: Optional: keep it inside a matter to share it with your colleagues.

laws.title: Laws
laws.intro: Read the current text of each loaded law, exactly as published, and compare it with earlier versions. No model is involved here.
laws.loadError: The laws could not be loaded. Please try again.
laws.notFound: That law has no such article.
laws.pick: Choose an article in the structure or type its number.
laws.citablesHelp: Each part has its own citation. You can copy it or save it to a matter.
laws.onlyVersion: Only one version of this article is recorded.
laws.diffLegend: Underlined text: added by the amendment. Struck-through text: removed.
laws.didNotExist: The article did not exist in that version.
laws.noLongerExists: The article no longer exists in the current version.

reforms.title: Amendments
reforms.intro: The system checks the official sources and, when a law changes, loads the new version without deleting the old one and tells you which part of your work cites amended provisions.
reforms.loadError: The amendments could not be loaded. Please try again.
reforms.noAlerts: None of your conversations, saved sources or verifications cites an amended provision.
reforms.noChanges: No amendment has been recorded yet.
reforms.checksHelp: If an official source refuses automated downloads, it is noted and not retried.
reforms.noChecks: No source has been checked yet.
reforms.bannerBody: {n} citations in your work point to provisions that changed.

verify.title: Verify citations
verify.intro: Check every article a brief cites: whether it exists, whether it is current and whether the quoted text matches the law. The check is done by the system, not by the model.
verify.mode: How do you want to provide the brief?
verify.docTitlePlaceholder: For example: Answer to the complaint
verify.textPlaceholder: Paste the whole brief here, or the part you want to check.
verify.example: Want to see how it works?
verify.exampleText: Con fundamento en el artículo 47, fracción II, de la Ley Federal del Trabajo, que establece como causa de rescisión "Incurrir el trabajador, durante sus labores, en faltas de probidad u honradez", así como en el artículo 48 de la misma ley. Véase también el artículo 21 de la Ley del Seguro Social.
verify.fileHelp: The PDF must contain text (not a scanned image). Reading it may take a minute or two.
verify.privacy: The brief is not stored: it is processed on this computer and only the report is kept (references and results, without the text).
verify.runningPdf: Reading the PDF and checking the references…

errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (15 MB maximum).
errors.unreadable: No text could be read from the file. Is it a scanned PDF?
errors.generic: The brief could not be verified. Please try again.

verify.none: No article references were found in the text.
verify.pdfWarnings: Note: part of the PDF could not be read well; review the result carefully.
verify.disclaimer: The check covers existence, validity and verbatim match. It does not judge whether the brief's interpretation is right.

statusHelp.vigente: The provision exists in the current version of the law.
statusHelp.derogado: The provision exists but is repealed in the current version.
statusHelp.no_vigente: The provision only exists in an earlier version: an amendment removed or replaced it.
statusHelp.inexistente: The law is loaded but has no such provision. Check the article or fraction number.
statusHelp.fuera_del_corpus: The cited law is not loaded in the system; it cannot be verified.
statusHelp.ley_no_identificada: It was not possible to tell which law the reference belongs to. Check that the brief names the law.
statusHelp.ambigua: The law's name matches more than one loaded law (for example, “Código Civil”).

quote.coincide_version_anterior: The quotation matches an earlier version

verify.inferred: The law is not named next to the reference: it was taken from the last law mentioned. Please confirm.
